title: Conditional finite full-Q mixture positivity and normalization support
purpose: Record a Lean-checked conditional lemma for finite convex sector mixtures. This support packet does not define a PAH sector law or a full-Q Gibbs state.

lean.scope: Finite type-indexed convex mixture of assumed positive normalized component functionals.

assumptions: Weights are supplied externally and are nonnegative.
Each component functional is positive on nonnegative test functions.
Each component functional evaluates the constant-one function to one.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The finite mixture is positive on nonnegative tests and evaluates the constant-one function to one.
not_supplied: No R-488 lower bound or stationarity passage.

non_claims: This theorem does not instantiate a PAH full-Q sector law, mu_(n,R) or omega.
It does not prove projective consistency, a cylinder limit, infinite-volume dynamics or stationarity.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
